title: Convert stored planning details
responsibility: Converts stored plan contracts, approvals, threads and messages into desktop display records.

inputs.name: planningConvert.plan
inputs.description: The stored plan with its contract fields and contract hash.

inputs.name: approvalInfo.record
inputs.description: The stored approval, including image records, version, contract hash, reviewer timestamp, current flag and optional design option.

inputs.name: threadInfo.thread
inputs.description: The stored thread with its pin, optional image anchor and messages.

inputs.name: messageInfo.message
inputs.description: The stored message, its author, text, mode, optional agent metadata and artifact references.

outputs.name: planningConvert
outputs.description: An entity contract retaining inputs, outputs and hash, and converting each error name into a field of type error.

outputs.name: approvalInfo
outputs.description: An approval summary with image hashes, version, contract hash, timestamp, current status and optional option.

outputs.name: threadInfo
outputs.description: A thread summary with its anchor and message count. Missing anchors become null image fields.

outputs.name: messageInfo
outputs.description: A display message whose person author becomes user and other authors become agent. Version comes from the first image reference, then notes, then a Change target; image hash comes from the first image reference. Missing agent details become null.
